notes.title: DEAD CRISIS!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40569965/82debbed9db8fe647f516ec8a064a83e6ad37938.png[/img]I greet you! 
Our beloved [b]Bio Crisis: Evil Hazard[/b] has been officially renamed to [b]Dead Crisis[/b].

There were several reasons for the renaming:
1. There are already 4 Biocrisises in the world (all cleverly combining biohazard and dinocrisis) XD
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1448800]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1448800[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1835570]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1835570[/url]
[url=https://krzysztoftracz.itch.io/biocrisis]https://krzysztoftracz.itch.io/biocrisis[/url]
[url=https://4pda.to/forum/index.php?showtopic=355819]https://4pda.to/forum/index.php?showtopic=355819[/url]

2. [b]Dead Crisis[/b] is a pun on Debt Crisis - a state's inability to fulfill its debt obligations, which creates a fun play on words.

3. [b]Dead Crisis[/b] also hints at another significant survival horror game that is hard to overstate in importance - Dead Space.

4. [b]Dead Crisis[/b] visually resembles [b]DinoCrisis[/b] XD

The [b]Dead Crisis[/b] Demo has been gathering dust here since '21
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1639640/Dead_Crisis_Demo/
You can try it out for free! And leave me your feedback!

Meanwhile, I softly [b]continue to develop[/b] this project. 
Because why not...

notes.title: Retro PC Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40569965/f8194b4a632ece0496fed4a8f4db7da0037b6f53.png[/img]

[h3]Hey there!
I've just updated the Demo

Here's what's new:
[list]
[*] A lots of optimization! Now you can play it on your [strike]patato [/strike] Retro PC :)
[*] Few QoL improvements!
[*] Ammo is reduced to the "Survival Horror" amount :)
[*] Dead Space styled ammo thing is gone! (it was a wip placeholder :)
[*] Some bugs fixed
[/list]

Now you can play it even on your microwave, as long as it has it's own graphic card XD
If you have some performance issues:
[olist]
[*] Go to Settings menu
[*] Switch to lowest resolution
[*] Toggle off all you can
[*] Enjoy your Retro Gaming!
[/olist][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40569965/f940ba39756013ec0418818dbc7b5eb5fd798dab.png[/img]

notes.title: Major Demo Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40569965/8e55c1e7603adbc55b441849bc056c7529239a67.png[/img]

[h3]Hey there Guys!
Thanks to your [b]Playtest Videos[/b], i'm able to make this game better!
This is the list of changes in the Updated version of a Demo!

[list]
[*] Logic Optimization
[*] Optimization of Ocean and Foliage
[*] Added the Map
[*] The game now knows if a gamepad is pluged, and showing the respective buttons in hints.
[*] Hints for small things. Weapon swap, Map, etc.
[*] Advanced settings added
[*] Not updating the health status during inventory heal - fixed
[*] Zombie surprise mechanic - fixed
[*] Character now able to walk with keyboard controlls
[*] Health status is now color-blind friendly
[*] Found Kittens are now saving (you don't have to collect them all every run)
[*] Reworked the sound of shotgun
[*] Lots of minor "quality of life improvements"
[*] Lots of minor bugs fixed
[/list]
[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625950/Bio_Crisis_Evil_Hazard/
[h3]
[b]Thank you for your feedback and videos!
Stay healthy and enjoy your playing![/b]
[/h3]
